question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.id AS sales_rep_id,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS rep_order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        CAST(SUM(rep_order_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(rep_total_sales), 2) AS total_sales
    FROM region_rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
ranked_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        rep_order_count,
        rep_total_sales,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS dr
    FROM region_rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    rt.total_orders,
    rt.total_sales,
    rr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(rr.rep_total_sales, 2) AS top_sales_rep_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN ranked_reps rr ON rr.region_name = rt.region_name AND rr.dr = 1
ORDER BY rt.region_name

    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        CAST(SUM(rep_order_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(rep_total_sales), 2) AS total_sales
    FROM region_rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
ranked_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        rep_order_count,
        rep_total_sales,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS dr
    FROM region_rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    rt.total_orders,
    rt.total_sales,
    rr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(rr.rep_total_sales, 2) AS top_sales_rep_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN ranked_reps rr ON rr.region_name = rt.region_name AND rr.dr = 1
ORDER BY rt.region_name
